requirements.text: A valid sales_manager order creation request returns HTTP 201 with code CREATED.
Each order line quantity is an integer from 1 through 100 inclusive; quantities 0 and 101 are rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.
The viewer role is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.title: Sales manager creates an order with a valid line quantity
preconditions: A sales_manager account is available and authenticated.
The order creation endpoint is available.
test_data: Order creation request with one order line whose quantity is 1.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request as the authenticated sales_manager.
steps.expected_result: The response has HTTP status 201 and response code CREATED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The valid sales_manager order creation request succeeds with HTTP 201 and code CREATED.

test_cases.title: Order line accepts the minimum allowed quantity
preconditions: A sales_manager account is available and authenticated.
The order creation endpoint is available.
test_data: Order creation request with one order line whose quantity is 1.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request with quantity 1 as the authenticated sales_manager.
steps.expected_result: The response does not have HTTP status 422 with error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 1 is accepted as the inclusive lower boundary.

test_cases.title: Order line accepts the maximum allowed quantity
preconditions: A sales_manager account is available and authenticated.
The order creation endpoint is available.
test_data: Order creation request with one order line whose quantity is 100.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request with quantity 100 as the authenticated sales_manager.
steps.expected_result: The response does not have HTTP status 422 with error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 100 is accepted as the inclusive upper boundary.

test_cases.title: Order line rejects a quantity below the allowed range
preconditions: A sales_manager account is available and authenticated.
The order creation endpoint is available.
test_data: Order creation request with one order line whose quantity is 0.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request with quantity 0 as the authenticated sales_manager.
steps.expected_result: The response has HTTP status 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 0 is rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Order line rejects a quantity above the allowed range
preconditions: A sales_manager account is available and authenticated.
The order creation endpoint is available.
test_data: Order creation request with one order line whose quantity is 101.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request with quantity 101 as the authenticated sales_manager.
steps.expected_result: The response has HTTP status 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 101 is rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Viewer is denied order creation
preconditions: A viewer account is available and authenticated.
The order creation endpoint is available.
test_data: Order creation request with one order line whose quantity is 1.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request as the authenticated viewer.
steps.expected_result: The response has HTTP status 403 and code FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The viewer is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
